idea-plugin.name: Highlight Companion
idea-plugin.description:
A cognitive-complexity gutter icon for Java and Kotlin methods, computed with the real algorithm from SonarSource's "Cognitive Complexity" whitepaper (control-flow nesting, mixed boolean operators, labeled break/continue, recursion) - not just a cyclomatic branch count.

The whole PSI walk that computes the number runs off the EDT, as part of the platform's own background "slow line markers" pass, and is cached per function so editing one file never recomputes anything in another. No freezes while analyzing source code, no IDE becoming unresponsive.

Every single rule - if/else, loops, switch/when, catch, mixed logical operators, labeled jumps, recursion - is individually toggle-able from Settings, with adjustable green/yellow/red thresholds. No rule is hardcoded on, no setting is silently disabled.

Free. No license nags, no telemetry, no popups.
